Adaptations are offered under CC BY-SA 4.0, using the later same-elements licence option in section 4(2) of the original Korean licence. Unmodified source text retains its original licence. National Institute of Korean Language, 2017 International Standard Curriculum for the Korean Language (vocabulary spreadsheet revised 2020): headword grade evidence, under Korea Open Government Licence Type 1 (attribution). https://www.korean.go.kr/front/reportData/reportDataView.do?mn_id=207&report_seq=932 .
